subject: Forest Temple
text: The Forest Temple is located in the Lost Woods.

evidence.quote: In the densely forested Lost Woods, there is the Forest Temple.

subject: Fire Temple
text: The Fire Temple is located in the midst of Death Mountain Crater.

evidence.quote: In the midst of the burning embers of Death Mountain Crater, there is the Fire Temple.

subject: Water Temple
text: The Water Temple is located underneath the surface of Lake Hylia.

evidence.quote: Underneath the surface of Lake Hylia is the Water Temple.

subject: Shadow Temple
text: The Shadow Temple is buried beneath the Kakariko Graveyard.

evidence.quote: Buried beneath the Kakariko Graveyard is the Shadow Temple.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: The Spirit Temple is located deep within the Gerudo Desert.

evidence.quote: Deep within the rugged Gerudo Desert is the Spirit Temple.

subject: Inside the Deku Tree
text: Inside the Deku Tree, players must climb down to the tree's roots to defeat the parasite sapping its strength.

evidence.quote: In the game's first dungeon, Inside the Deku Tree, players must open up passages in the Deku Tree's main chamber, climbing from the Tree's top to it's bottom, finally reaching the Tree's roots and defeating the parasite that is sapping it's strength.

subject: Dodongo's Cavern
text: In Dodongo's Cavern, players must reach the top of a giant Dodongo skull and open its mouth to reach King Dodongo.

evidence.quote: In Dodongo's Cavern, players must climb to the top of a massive Dodongo's skull and force it's mouth open, opening a passage to the King Dodongo.

subject: Jabu-Jabu's Belly
text: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly, players must destroy parasitic tentacles to reveal a path to the parasite in the brain.

evidence.quote: In Jabu-Jabu's Belly, players must destroy parasitic tentacles that sap Jabu-Jabu's strength, finally revealing a path to the parasite in Jabu-Jabu's brain.

subject: Forest Temple
text: In the Forest Temple, defeating four Poes that stole magic flames opens the passage to the boss chamber.

evidence.quote: In the Forest Temple, players must track down and kill four elusive Poes who have stolen magic flames, which open the passage to the boss chamber.

subject: Fire Temple
text: In the Fire Temple, players must climb to the top of the structure to create a bridge leading to the boss.

evidence.quote: In the Fire Temple, players must climb clear to the top of the massive structure, in order to create a bridge to the boss at the bottom of the Temple.

subject: Water Temple
text: In the Water Temple, players must raise and lower the water level to access different areas of the dungeon.

evidence.quote: In the Water Temple, players must proactively raise and lower the water level in the Temple in order to reach the different areas of the dungeon (a Temple which, may I add, has irked Ocarina players for over a decade).

subject: Shadow Temple
text: In the Shadow Temple, players must navigate through wide expanses filled with deadly traps.

evidence.quote: In the Shadow Temple, players must cross great expanses of deadly traps in an almost Indiana Jones-esque environment.

subject: Spirit Temple
text: Completing both wings of the Spirit Temple requires traveling through time.

evidence.quote: In the Spirit Temple, players have to travel through time in order to complete both wings of the dungeon.

subject: Ganon's Castle
text: In Ganon's Castle, players must break the six seals located in the Keep.

evidence.quote: And lastly, in Ganon's Castle, players must destroy the six Seals in the Keep.

subject: Link
text: Opening the Door of Time and pulling the Master Sword transforms Young Link into Adult Link seven years in the future.

evidence.quote: After opening the Door of Time and drawing the Master Sword from it's pedestal, Young Link immediately finds himself awakening seven years in the future, and he has become a full-grown Adult.

subject: Temple of Time
text: Link can travel between childhood and adulthood by visiting the Temple of Time with the Master Sword and Ocarina of Time.

evidence.quote: What's more, thanks to the magic of the Master Sword and the Ocarina of Time, Link gains the ability to travel back and forth between his childhood and his adulthood, simply by visiting the Temple of Time.

subject: Magic Bean
text: Actions taken as child Link, such as planting magic beans, directly influence the future.

evidence.quote: Actions that Link performs as a child, be it planting a magic bean, uncovering a new item, or forging a special bond with a denizen of Hyrule directly affect the future.

subject: Bombchus
text: Bombchus crawl along walls and ceilings in a straight line before exploding.

evidence.quote: New items in the series include the unorthodox and under-utilized Bombchus (which crawl along walls and ceilings in a straight line before finally exploding)...

subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth reveals invisible objects and causes illusory surfaces to disappear.

evidence.quote: ...and the Lens of Truth (which reveals things for what they truly are, making the invisible visible, and the fake disappear).

subject: Tunics
text: Different tunics allow Link to breathe underwater or endure intense heat, and can be swapped at any time.

evidence.quote: In Ocarina, new tunics grant Link the ability to breath underwater or withstand tremendous heat, and the player can change between available tunics at will.

subject: Kokiri Sword
text: The Kokiri Sword is the only sword small enough for Young Link to equip.

evidence.quote: The Kokiri Sword, which is little more then a large knife, is the only weapon small enough for Young Link to brandish.

subject: Biggoron's Sword
text: The Biggoron's Sword is a two-handed blade that prevents Adult Link from using a shield and cannot be swung in narrow halls.

evidence.quote: The Biggoron's Sword, on the other hand, is so massive that Adult Link can't use a shield while wielding it, and has such a wide reach that the blade is impossible to use in narrow corridors.

subject: Hylian Shield
text: Young Link cannot wield the Hylian Shield normally and instead crouches beneath it like a shell.

evidence.quote: Even the way Young Link and Adult Link use the Hylian Shield is markedly different. Though both can equip the shield, it is too big for Young Link to actually use, and he instead has to resort to hiding under it like a shell.

subject: Zelda's Lullaby
text: Zelda's Lullaby proves Link's royal allegiance to the Gorons and Zoras, and activates secrets in adult dungeons.

evidence.quote: One of the first songs you learn, Zelda's Lullaby, is used by Young Link to show his allegiance to the Hyrule Royal Family to the Gorons and Zoras, and is later used by Adult Link in the dungeons and other hidden locations of Hyrule.

subject: Epona's Song
text: Playing Epona's Song is the only method to acquire Link's horse, Epona.

evidence.quote: Epona's Song is the only way to obtain Epona, Link's legendary horse.

subject: Sun's Song
text: The Sun's Song changes day into night and night into day.

evidence.quote: The Sun's Song possesses the power to turn day into night, and night into day.

subject: Song of Storms
text: The Song of Storms calls down a rainstorm at Link's current position.

evidence.quote: The Song of Storm's can summon storms to Link's location.

subject: Ocarina
text: Playing songs on the Ocarina allows Link to warp instantly across different destinations in Hyrule.

evidence.quote: But the Ocarina is used more then to just play music; later, he can use it to travel instantaneously between different locations in Hyrule.

subject: Z-Targeting
text: Navi enables Z-Targeting to lock Link's view onto a single foe and swap his controls for battle.

evidence.quote: Navi nevertheless performs a pivotal action in the game: Z-Targeting....Z-Targeting allows Link to focus his attention on a single target, and radically alters his moveset to focus on combat.

subject: Z-Targeting Jump Attacks
text: While Z-Targeted, the A button strafes left or right, executes a backflip when moving backward, or unleashes a Jump Attack when tilting forward.

evidence.quote: While Z-Targeted, however, it causes Link to perform different jumping actions. Jumping to the left or right will strafe in a circle around the enemy, while a backwards jump will make Link do a backflip. A jump while holding forward causes Link to perform the Jump Attack, the most powerful attack in his repertoire.

subject: Shield Mobility
text: Holding the R button while Z-Targeted allows Link to keep moving while guarding with his shield.

evidence.quote: While in free-form camera mode, the R Button activates Link's shield. However, it also makes him completely stationary. While Z-Targeted, however, holding the R button will tell Link to raise his shield, but he still maintains his mobility.

subject: Z-Targeting Sword Strikes
text: While Z-Targeted, tapping the B Button causes Link to perform a downward plunge attack, while holding forward and B causes him to stab.

evidence.quote:
While in free-
form mode, tapping the B Button will cause Link to perform a sideways, sweeping
attack.  While Z-Targeted, however, this attack becomes a downward plunge.
Holding forward and B will cause Link to stab, or a whole new assortment of
cool attacks.
